text:
Maya (CS): FYI Opal Finance requesting a short APAC QPS raise for an investor demo next Fri. They want ~300 QPS for ~3 hours. Renewal flagged as high priority.
Ethan (SE): Which endpoints/models + region? Need CIDRs for allowlist too.
Maya (CS): Customer provided: region ap-southeast-1 (SG). Endpoints: /v1/generate (gpt-redwood-8k) and /v1/embeddings. Current per-org QPS=60, requested=300. Window: 2024-11-15 09:00-12:00 SGT. IPs: 52.74.128.0/22, 13.250.0.0/16.
Liam (NetOps): We can add a temporary edge allowlist and a timebound policy. Need org ID and api key nonce for audit.
Maya (CS): Org: opal-finance-prod. We'll post the full key into a support ticket for security. Customer asked for auto-revoke.
Ava (Support): Opening ticket now for tracking and signed addendum. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/87642. Attachments will follow.
Ethan (SE): Suggest we apply a model override to keep CPU/GPU safe: set gpt-redwood-8k -> reduced-batch for /v1/generate and enable prefix KV caching. Proposed payload:
```
{
  "org": "opal-finance-prod",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "qps": "300",
  "window": "2024-11-15T09:00:00+08:00/2024-11-15T12:00:00+08:00",
  "allowlist": ["52.74.128.0/22","13.250.0.0/16"],
  "model_overrides": {"/v1/generate": "gpt-redwood-8k:reduced-batch"},
  "auto_revoke": "true"
}
```
Liam (NetOps): OK. We'll implement as a temp policy with an automatic rollback. I'll add a fallback throttle at 120 QPS if backend pressure rises. ETA ~20m after approval to apply.
ops-bot: Change request created: #CR-9221  temp-qps-opal-finance-prod-ap-southeast-1 assigned to Liam.
Liam (NetOps): Applied. Edge CIDRs added, routing updated, QPS rule live, fallback 120 QPS, auto-revoke scheduled for 2024-11-15T12:05:00+08:00. Canary returns 200 OK.
Ava (Support): Uploaded the signed addendum and rollback plan to ticket 87642, note added: "temp QPS exception granted per addendum".
Maya (CS): Noted. I'll flag renewal ops and attach the addendum to the opportunity. Customer will run stress tests tomorrow and report.
Ethan (SE): I'll watch latencies/error rates during window and keep an eval check for quality drift due to reduced-batch.
Liam (NetOps): Quick cost estimate for billing ops: ~USD 450 increment for the 3h burst, I will confirm post-window.
ops-bot: Change request #CR-9221 status=applied auto-revoke=scheduled.
Maya (CS): Closing loop: demo succeeded, customer said it materially improved renewal sentiment. Please attach final cost to ticket for renewal team. :tada:
